field_meaning.hi: Screen पर बिना ध्यान भटकाए visual data दिखाना।

review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi definition describes the general concept of displaying data on a screen without distraction, but a Head-Up Display (HUD) specifically refers to an optical system that projects information onto a transparent surface (like a windshield or visor) so the user does not have to look away from their primary task. The provided definition is too generic and misses the key 'projection' or 'overlay' aspect.
Google: The Hindi meaning describes the purpose rather than defining the term itself as a visual element or interface component.
